newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel to close structural mill.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel to close structural mill.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said Thursday efforts to sell Bethlehem Structural Products Corp's structural mill have been unsuccessful, despite a major marketing program, and therefore, the mill in Bethlehem, Pa., will cease operations during the first quarter.
Shipments from inventory may continue for a period of time, the company said.
Bethlehem Steel said efforts announced October 30 to sell BethForge, CENTEC and BethShip's Sparrows Point Yard are ongoing, and negotiations are continuing with qualified buyers for these businesses.
As previously announced, the company said, about 900 jobs will be affected by the structural mill closing, and outplacement assistance will be offered to affected employees.
Bethlehem Steel said it has issued a notice to the United Steelworkers of America of its intention to cease operations at the Bethlehem Structural Products structural mill.
The notice was issued in accordance with the 1993 labor agreement between the company and the union to provide 90 days advance notification of a possible permanent closing of facilities.
